evidence_items.title: Ai2 and Taylor Geospatial partner to make geospatial AI easier to compare, run, and build on
evidence_items.summary: Ai2 and Taylor Geospatial are partnering to make geospatial AI more accessible and useful for the public good through open models, shared benchmarks, and improved satellite imagery datasets for applications in conservation, agriculture, and humanitarian work.

evidence_items.title: [AINews] GPT-6.2 Astra, the #2 Frontier Model is better and 20%-600% cheaper, but has mixed reviews; 6.2 Sol likely main workhorse
